svg.title: Matryoshka architecture sweep: KV-cache memory versus inference FLOPs
svg.desc: Static snapshot of the original student-created interactive Chart.js figure with reconstructed candidate architectures, the chosen 24-10-5 model, and Vanilla 3B reference lines. X axis is KB per token. Y axis is GFLOPs per token.
svg.text: KV cache vs. theoretical inference FLOPs (reconstructed from Appendix B)
